name: GENTING
recent: Genting Berhad 正在推进约 RM1,250 million 的可放弃供股计划，Bursa Securities 已于 2026 年 11 月 20 日批准最多 1,540,230,439 股供股股份上市。公司 2026 财年第三季度由盈转亏，新加坡与马来西亚业务表现疲弱。此外，Genting Group 已暂停 Sycal 在云顶高原的 Sky City 项目。
notable: 拟筹集约 RM1,250 million 总收益。
Bursa Securities 批准最多 1,540,230,439 股供股股份上市及报价。
2026 财年第三季度业绩由盈转亏，净亏损 RM161.4 million。
risks: 供股计划涉及发行最多 1,540,230,439 股新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
Bursa Securities 就供股计划发出询问，要求说明折价基准及营运资金分配明细。
2026 财年第三季度净亏损 RM161.4 million，而上一季度为净利。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM7,746.1 million，环比增长 16.2%，同比增长 14.2%；净亏损为 RM27.1 million，净利率为 -0.3%，而上一季度净利率为 1.5%。

recent_en: Genting Berhad is proceeding with a renounceable rights issue to raise approximately RM1,250 million, with Bursa Securities approving the listing of up to 1,540,230,439 rights shares on 20 November 2026. The company swung into a 3Q loss for FY2026, dragged by weaker Singapore and Malaysia operations. Separately, Genting Group has halted Sycal's Sky City project in Genting Highlands.
notable_en: Proposed renounceable rights issue to raise gross proceeds of approximately RM1,250 million.
Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of up to 1,540,230,439 rights shares.
Swung to a 3Q FY2026 net loss of RM161.4 million from a profit a year earlier.
risks_en: The rights issue involves up to 1,540,230,439 new shares, potentially diluting existing shareholders.
Bursa Securities issued a query on the rights issue, requesting justification for the discount and breakdown of working capital allocation.
3Q FY2026 recorded a net loss of RM161.4 million versus a net profit in the preceding quarter.
earnings_en: For 2Q FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was RM7,746.1 million, up 16.2% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; net loss was RM27.1 million with a net margin of -0.3%, compared with a net margin of 1.5% in the preceding quarter.
